statement:
Trip TR-118 lists the outbound flight as **16 March**, but the conference ends on 15 March and Dana’s talk is on the morning of 13 March.

Should I book **12 March** instead, so she arrives before her talk? I haven’t booked anything yet.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer identifies the specific contradiction — the flight out on 16 March postdates the conference end and her 13 March talk — and offers the corrected date (12 March).
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
